dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: This baseline keeps the classic admin rhythm and layout while staying intentionally minimal.

panel.title: Dashboard
panel.description: The scaffold ships with a compact but complete default workspace.
panel.welcome: The main area starts with a simple welcome block so the default menu has a useful landing page.
panel.extend: You can keep building on top of this shell by adding customer, order, settings, or any other business modules.

desc.dark: Easier on the eyes in low light

language.note: Switching language updates labels across the admin surface. Form data is unaffected.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.body: You'll be returned to the sign-in screen on this device. Any unsaved drafts in open wizards may be lost.
signOut.note: Active sessions on other devices will continue. Sign them out from Account & security → Sessions.

profile.title: My profile
profile.sub: Manage your personal details and sign-in.

identity.verifyOldDesc: To protect your account, enter the 6-digit code we sent to your current email {email}.
identity.newEmailDesc: Enter the new email address you want to use to sign in.
identity.newUsernameDesc: Pick a new username. This is your login handle.
identity.verifyNewDesc: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to your new email {email}.
identity.doneEmail: Your email is now {email}. For security you'll be signed out — sign back in with your new email.

err.incorrectCode: Incorrect code. Check the latest code and try again.

err.wrongCode: Incorrect code. Check your authenticator app for the current code.
err.reqsNotMet: New password does not meet every requirement.
err.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

authn.verifyDesc: Changing your authenticator is sensitive, so first confirm a code from your current authenticator.
authn.scanDesc: In your authenticator app, remove the old {app} entry, then scan this new setup key.
authn.setupKeyLabel: Can't scan? Enter this setup key
authn.confirmDesc: Enter the 6-digit code shown for the new {app} entry to confirm it's working.
authn.openApp: Open your authenticator app for the current code.

err.wrongCurrent: Incorrect code. Check your current authenticator.
err.wrongNew: That code doesn't match. Scan the new key, then enter its current code.
